endingAgePolicy.statement: The current LOW+Batch008 age shape is acceptable for Human Playtest Round 2. Improve coherence/timing when possible, but do not increase overall lethality solely to force the original age buckets.
endingAgePolicy.laterLever: Earlier faction influence/contact may be explored later; not in H2B.1A.

corrections.change: Replace the broad MNY>=6 clean settlement with TLT[T1013] | MNY>=10. Recovery from the rescue itself must not erase the obligation.

If the obligation survives the follow-up, schedule new maturation event EVT-INS-FIN-2004 3-5 years later, roughly ages 25-31. It may add +8 to +12 FIX and/or commit exactly one clearly evidenced material; ambiguous/no evidence must not choose arbitrarily. Feed the existing finance route/climax; no new ending.

Once a relief/collateral event creates debtor/obligation state, escalation depends on that obligation plus FIX/material evidence, not on remaining poor. Wealth/legal talent may still permit genuine pre-COMMITTED opt-out.

Add data-driven post-event trigger: AGE>=18 & STR<=-3 with no active/recent review schedules EVT-INS-MED-2001 next year. Widen review coverage through supported old age. Trigger schedules a review, never an ending.
Order: STR>=3 recovery; STR<=-3 expedited; TLT[T1015] | (MNY>=10 & INT>=12) exceptional independent treatment; fallback covered stabilization.
Order: STR>=3 recovery; TLT[T1015] | (MNY>=10 & INT>=12) exceptional alternative; existing MAT benefit; single clear manifestation benefit; ambiguous/no evidence SYNT.
Preserve MAT if committed. If MAT=NONE and exactly one clear manifestation exists, may stabilize that family. If none/ambiguous, SYNT. Never arbitrary first-match.
T1024/T1013 negotiate self-owned structural continuation instead of automatic exit; high MNY can remain clean buyout. Add ROUTE_ARC_SELF_OWNED and use it to reach END-LEG-002.
Tighten genuine lottery eligibility to MNY<=0; keep once-per-run LOW, no FIX, no hidden drawback.
Add metadata-only relocation tag and apply to literal residence-change events/variants. No flag prefix/drafting Favor. Replace analyst relocation list.
Prose-only age-1 wording fix supplied in design spec.
Generate contributor audit for CHR/INT/SPR by age band. Do not mass-edit stat effects in H2B.1A.

focusedRegression.reference: Use committed H2B Batch008 findings as reference unless exact prepatch in-process comparison is already cheap.

soft: completion broadly playable (~45-70 useful review band)
